facts.fact: KBC reports the NYOTA AGPO training covers registering and bidding on the government's electronic procurement systems, IFMIS and e-GP, as stated by the MSME Principal Secretary at the launch.

KEN.note: Training is for young entrepreneurs, not civil servants.
IFMIS is named only as a bidding system taught in a course; its use across central government is not stated.

facts.fact: The State Department for MSMEs launched the NYOTA AGPO Digital Training Programme, a free 10-week self-paced course targeting more than 600,000 young entrepreneurs; no number trained is given.

KEN.note: Persons with disabilities are only eligible beneficiaries of a procurement course; nothing on accessible information or digital services.
